name: 7SABER
note: Uzbek sportswear brand presented in Tashkent in June 2021. The emblem was created by Otabek Umarov; brand rights were licensed for five years to OOO Urban Hayot, a company founded by Ross Connon (head of Dubai-based Berkeley Square Investments) and Oraz Abdurazakov (Spot, 2021-06-26; Olympic.uz, 2021-06-26). Uzbek register entries list 7SABER-named limited-liability companies (orginfo.uz). No state ownership found.
